answers.reason: H1452 derives from Gederah (H1449), whereas Gederites H1451 derives from Geder (H1445). None of the candidates denotes the inhabitants of Gederah.
Calebites H3614 denotes the clan associated with Caleb H3612. None of the candidates represents that clan.
Macbannites H4344 derives from Machbenah H4343. The candidates have different ancestral or geographic origins.

Both carry H1336, but Khirbet al Yahud is a proposed settlement identification while the candidate explicitly treats Bether in SNG 2:17 as an adjective. These competing interpretations do not establish a shared geographic referent.
Gomorrha is the Greek NT spelling of Gomorrah, as in MAT 10:15. Both records explicitly share G1116.
Olivet G1638 names the Mount of Olives in ACT 1:12. No candidate is supplied.
Zabulon G2194 denotes Zebulun as a tribe or its territory, including MAT 4:13–15. The candidate zebulun-2 is the town where Elon was buried in JDG 12:12.
G2455 includes Judah as the tribe named in HEB 7:14 and HEB 8:8, both attached to judah-6. The Judea candidates represent the geographic region under different headwords.
Sychem is the Greek NT spelling of Shechem in ACT 7:16. The Tell Balatah candidate explicitly shares G4966.
Chaldaean G5466 is the gentilic used in 'land of the Chaldaeans' in ACT 7:4. The Chaldea candidate explicitly includes this Greek headword and Strong number.
